title: Apparel Return Window
text: Apparel items can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery when they are unused and have their original tags attached.

title: Apparel Return Window
text: Items that show signs of use, washing, or damage may be rejected during inspection.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Footwear can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery when it is unused and returned with the original packaging.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Shoes showing outdoor wear or damage may not qualify for return.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics can generally be returned within 10 days of delivery for qualifying defects or issues covered by the product policy.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Customers may be asked to complete troubleshooting or provide diagnostic information before a return is approved.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Eligible home products can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and meet the applicable return conditions.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Large or assembled items may have additional return restrictions.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For an eligible COD return, the refund is normally initiated after the returned item passes the required inspection.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: Once initiated, the refund may take several business days to reach the customer's selected refund method.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: For prepaid orders, an eligible refund is normally initiated after the returned item passes the required inspection.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: The time taken for the refund to appear can depend on the original payment method and banking network.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery dates depend on the seller, destination, inventory availability, and logistics route.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: The expected delivery date shown for the order is the primary estimate used for customer communication.

title: Delayed Delivery
text: If an order passes its expected delivery date, customers should check the latest tracking status before requesting further assistance.

title: Delayed Delivery
text: Logistics delays can occur because of weather, operational disruptions, or route constraints.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available for eligible return requests in serviceable locations.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Pickup availability depends on the product, seller policy, return reason, and logistics coverage for the customer's address.

title: Self-Ship Return
text: If reverse pickup is unavailable for an eligible return, the customer may be offered a self-ship return option where supported.

title: Self-Ship Return
text: Instructions for packaging and shipping should be followed exactly to avoid delays in processing.

title: Return Inspection
text: Returned products can be inspected before the return is approved.

title: Return Inspection
text: Missing accessories, altered products, physical damage, or signs of use can affect return eligibility.

title: Damaged Product
text: Customers should report a product that arrives damaged as soon as possible through the applicable support or return workflow.

title: Damaged Product
text: Photos or other evidence may be requested to help determine the appropriate resolution.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: If a customer receives a product different from the item ordered, the issue should be reported through the return or support workflow.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: The order details and delivered product may be checked before a replacement or refund is approved.

title: Return Packaging
text: Customers should return eligible products with the original packaging and included accessories whenever required by the product policy.

title: Return Packaging
text: Incomplete packaging can affect inspection and return approval.

title: Cancellation Before Shipment
text: An order may generally be cancelled before it reaches the shipment stage when cancellation is available for that order.

title: Cancellation Before Shipment
text: Once an order has entered certain shipping stages, cancellation may no longer be available.

title: Exchange Eligibility
text: Exchange availability depends on the product category, seller policy, inventory, and the reason for the exchange.

title: Exchange Eligibility
text: If an exchange is unavailable, an eligible return and refund may be offered instead.
